DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception.

The clinical presentation of an 8-month-old with intermittent abdominal pain (crying with tenderness), feeding difficulties, abdominal distension, and the absence of fever or diarrhea is highly suggestive of intussusception. This condition requires immediate evaluation and potential surgical or radiologic intervention to prevent bowel ischemia and perforation.
